page: Amazon Web Services x2iedn.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 128 vCPUs and 64 physical cores from an Intel Xeon 8375C processor operating at 3.5 GHz with a 54 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 4096.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, providing 32.0 GB of RAM per physical core. Local storage consists of a 3800 GB NVMe SSD, and the network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core capabilities, with the server achieving top-tier performance in CPU encryption and ray tracing tests. Memory bandwidth is also highly rated, reaching 302.32 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Database operations are supported by strong Redis SET throughput of 106.84 million operations per second. However, single-core performance remains in the average tier, and text generation for large 70B language models is weak, registering at 2.76 tokens per second.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and integrated local NVMe storage, this server offers high resource density for memory-bound applications. It is designed for large-scale in-memory databases, heavy database operations, and memory-intensive enterprise applications. The lack of GPU acceleration makes it less suitable for heavy deep learning training, but its massive RAM capacity and 100 Gbps network bandwidth support demanding data-processing pipelines and high-throughput web serving.
